series.name: Multi F(DX) multi-split fault codes (CH01-CH61, Lo)
series.notes: LG Multi F(DX) Fault Codes Sheet (Macedo, Nov 2007, service manual PDF). Multi-split product line (not full VRF Multi V). CH aliases per sheet; fascia red/green flash maps. High.

meaning.en: Indoor air sensor open or short circuit.
meaning.ur: Indoor air sensor khula ya short circuit ho gaya.

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or thermistor failed
causes.ur: Sensor connector loose ya thermistor kharab
Harness kharab

solutions.en: Reseat sensor; measure curve; replace if bad
solutions.ur: Sensor dobara lagayein, napein; kharab ho to replace karein

solutions.en: Power cycle after repair
solutions.ur: Marammat ke baad power cycle karein

meaning.ur: Inlet pipe sensor khula ya short.

causes.ur: Connector sahi se nahi laga
Thermistor kharab

solutions.en: Reseat and replace sensor if out of curve
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein; ghalat ho to replace karein

solutions.en: Check indoor PCB socket
solutions.ur: Andar ka PCB socket check karein

title.en: Indoor to wired remote data communication fault
title.ur: Indoor se wired remote data communication fault

meaning.en: Data communication fault between indoor unit and wired remote.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit aur wired remote ke darmiyan data communication fault.

causes.en: Group-control switch or 3-wire remote cable fault
causes.ur: Group-control switch ya 3-wire remote cable kharab
Signal line khula/short

solutions.en: Set DIP Group/GR1; reset 2 minutes
solutions.ur: DIP Group/GR1 set karein, phir 2 minute ka reset dein

solutions.en: Measure 12V and fluctuating signal on remote cable
solutions.ur: Remote cable par 12V aur fluctuating signal napein

title.en: Drain pump / float switch open circuit
title.ur: Drain pump / float switch khula (open circuit)

meaning.en: Float switch open (high level water alarm) or CN FLOAT jumper missing without drain pump.
meaning.ur: Float switch khula (paani high level alarm) ya drain pump wale unit mein CN FLOAT jumper missing

causes.ur: Drain block ya float atka hua
CN FLOAT jumper missing
Drain pump kharab

solutions.en: Drain and clean; power reset to clear (3.5 min display delay, 40s lockout)
solutions.ur: Paani nikalein aur saaf karein, phir power reset dein — display 3.5 minute baad clear hoga aur 40 second lockout rahega

solutions.en: Refit jumper if missing
solutions.ur: Jumper missing ho to dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace pump if seized
solutions.ur: Pump jam ho gaya ho to replace karein

title.ur: Indoor se outdoor communication mein kharabi

meaning.en: Data communication fault indoor to outdoor; outdoor end shows 53. Serial signal lost within ~5 min of power-up.
meaning.ur: Indoor se outdoor data communication fault; outdoor end par 53 aata hai. Power-up ke ~5 minute ke andar serial signal khatam ho jata hai.

causes.en: Miswiring or condensate pump wired onto interconnect cable
causes.ur: Galat wiring ya condensate pump ke taar interconnect cable par lage hain

causes.en: Loose terminals or open/short to ground (normal >2 Mohm to GND)
causes.ur: Loose terminal ya ground se open/short (normal >2 Mohm to GND)
IDU/ODU par mains voltage galat (230V ±10% hona chahiye)

causes.en: IDU PCB or ODU PCB fault
causes.ur: IDU PCB ya ODU PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check both supplies 230V±10%; fix miswiring/loose connections; comm-GND >2 Mohm
solutions.ur: Dono supply 230V±10% check karein; galat wiring/loose connection theek karein; comm-GND >2 Mohm

solutions.en: Start IDU in cooling 18C — serial only first ~3 min; measure 0-72V DC on ODU terminal 5 to 2/earth
solutions.ur: IDU ko cooling 18C par chalaayein — serial sirf pehle ~3 minute; ODU terminal 5 se 2/earth par 0-72V DC napein

solutions.en: Isolate terminal 5: steady -0.1 to -10V implies cable or IDU PCB; no voltage = IDU PCB; present = cable
solutions.ur: Terminal 5 isolate karein: -0.1 se -10V stable rahe to cable ya IDU PCB; voltage na ho to IDU PCB; voltage ho to cable

solutions.en: If one indoor runs, ODU PCB generally OK
solutions.ur: Agar aik indoor chal raha ho to ODU PCB aam tor par theek hai

notes.ur: CH05 andar ka aur 53 bahar ka — dono ka ek hi fault hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fascia: red none / green 5 flash; ODU LED red 5x / green 3x for code 53

meaning.ur: Outlet pipe sensor khula ya short circuit.

causes.ur: Connector loose ya thermistor kharab
plg par zng/nmy

solutions.en: Disconnect mains power, then reseat the outlet pipe sensor connector at both the sensor and PCB ends.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle bijli band karein, phir outlet pipe sensor ke connector ko dono taraf — sensor aur PCB — par dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance with a multimeter at room temperature and compare it with the known-good curve; if it reads open or short, replace the thermistor.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se kamre ke temperature par sensor ki resistance naapein aur theek curve se compare karein; open ya short nikle to thermistor badal dein.

solutions.en: Inspect the PCB socket for corrosion or dry joints, clean or repair it, then power on and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: PCB socket mein corrosion ya dry joints dekhein, saaf karke theek karein, phir power on karke confirm karein ke code clear ho gaya.

meaning.en: Indoor unit set in different cool/heat mode than master.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit master se alag cool/heat mode par hai

causes.en: Slave cooling while master heating (or reverse)
causes.ur: Slave cooling par hai aur master heating par (ya iska ulta)

causes.en: Master off so another unit took master role with different mode
causes.ur: Master band ho gaya to doosra unit master ban gaya jiska mode alag tha

solutions.en: Turn off all remotes, power on, set all to same mode
solutions.ur: Tamam remotes band karein, power on karein, sab ko aik hi mode par set karein

solutions.en: Fault clears when modes match
solutions.ur: Modes match hone par fault clear ho jata hai

meaning.en: EEPROM checksum mismatching on indoor PCB.
meaning.ur: Indoor PCB ka EEPROM checksum match nahi ho raha

causes.en: EEPROM loose in socket or dry joints
causes.ur: EEPROM socket mein loose ya dry joints
Galat PCB assembly

solutions.en: Disconnect power, open the indoor unit safely, and reseat the EEPROM chip fully in its socket.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, indoor unit kholte waqt ehtiyat karein aur EEPROM chip ko uske socket mein poori tarah dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the EEPROM socket and nearby solder joints under light for dry joints or cracks; reflow or repair them if found.
solutions.ur: Light mein EEPROM socket aur aas-paas ke solder joints dekhein ke dry ya toote hue to nahi; mil jaye to reflow ya repair karein.

solutions.en: If the checksum still fails, confirm the PCB assembly matches this model and replace the indoor PCB only as a last step.
solutions.ur: Agar checksum phir bhi fail ho, to PCB assembly ka model se match confirm karein aur aakhir mein zaroorat pade to indoor PCB badlein.

title.ur: Andar ka BLDC fan motor lock

meaning.en: Fan motor not operating — rotation not detected on indoor BLDC fan.
meaning.ur: Fan motor kaam nahi kar raha — andar wale BLDC fan ki rotation detect nahi ho rahi.

causes.ur: Motor jam hua ya fan block

causes.en: Winding open/short or PCB drive fault
causes.ur: Winding open/short ya PCB drive fault

causes.en: Hall feedback fault (fast spin then stop)
causes.ur: Hall feedback kharab (tez ghoomne ke baad ruk jata hai)

solutions.en: Free wheel; test windings and PCB power to motor
solutions.ur: Bijli band karke pahiya azad karein, phir windings aur motor ko di PCB power test karein

solutions.en: Check 5-wire harness (360V DC / 15V / 0-5V speed)
solutions.ur: 5-wire harness check karein (360V DC / 15V / 0-5V speed)

solutions.en: Replace motor or PCB
solutions.ur: Motor ya PCB replace karein

codes.blinkPattern: Fascia: red 1 flash / green none (display CA)

title.ur: IPM fault ya compressor ka overcurrent

meaning.en: Inverter DC overcurrent >14A; compressor or inverter PCB fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter DC current >14A; compressor ya inverter PCB kharab.

causes.ur: Compressor short ho ya earth se juda ho
Inverter PCB/IPM kharab hona
Compressor jam (seized)

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supply, then check the compressor winding to earth with a megger; any leakage means the compressor is bad.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karke supply alag karein, phir megger se compressor winding ki earth checking karein; leakage nikle to compressor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Measure the compressor winding resistance with an ohmmeter for an open or shorted winding; replace the compressor if it fails this test.
solutions.ur: Ohmmeter se compressor ki winding resistance naapein ke open ya short to nahi; test fail ho to compressor badal dein.

solutions.en: If the windings are good, test the inverter PCB output stage and IPM, then replace the failed inverter module or PCB and retest before running.
solutions.ur: Winding theek ho to inverter PCB ka output stage aur IPM test karein; kharab inverter module ya PCB badlein aur chalane se pehle dobara test karein.

meaning.en: Pressure switch open circuit; LP <0.5 bar or HP >41 bar; latch after 5 trips/hour.
meaning.ur: Pressure switch open circuit; LP <0.5 bar ya HP >41 bar; 1 ghante mein 5 trips par latch

causes.en: Low charge or high pressure condition
causes.ur: Gas kam ya pressure zyada
CN PRESS link gayab

solutions.en: Disconnect power and isolate the unit before checking the pressure switch and the LP/HP readings on the gauge.
solutions.ur: Pehle bijli band karke unit ko alag karein, phir pressure switch aur gauge par LP/HP readings check karein.

solutions.en: Find what is tripping the switch — low charge means leak-test and correct the charge, high pressure means clean the condenser coil and clear the airflow.
solutions.ur: Pata karein ke switch kyun trip ho raha hai — gas kam ho to leak test karke charge theek karein, pressure zyada ho to condenser coil saaf karke airflow khali karein.

solutions.en: If the CN PRESS link is missing, refit it, then reset the outdoor unit for 2 minutes and confirm the latch clears.
solutions.ur: Agar CN PRESS link gayab ho to dobara lagayein, phir outdoor unit ka 2 minute ka reset dein aur confirm karein ke latch clear ho gaya.

meaning.ur: AC input abnormal — 140V se neeche ya 300V se upar

causes.ur: Utility voltage range se bahar

causes.en: ODU PCB voltage-sense fault if supply OK
causes.ur: Supply theek ho to ODU PCB ka voltage-sense fault

solutions.en: Measure mains under load; stabilizer if needed
solutions.ur: Load par mains voltage napein; zaroorat ho to stabilizer lagayein

solutions.en: Replace ODU PCB if supply normal
solutions.ur: Supply normal ho to ODU PCB badal dein

meaning.en: Discharge sensor high temperature on inverter compressor.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ke discharge sensor ka temperature zyada ho jana.

causes.ur: gys km ya rkaot
Condenser airflow kharab

solutions.en: Power off and let the unit cool down, then reset for 2 minutes before reading the discharge temperature again.
solutions.ur: Power off karke unit ko thanda hone dein, phir 2 minute ke liye reset rakhein aur dobara discharge temperature padhein.

solutions.en: Leak-test the system, correct the refrigerant charge and check the EEV if the charge or expansion is wrong.
solutions.ur: System ka leak test karein, refrigerant charge theek karein aur agar charge ya expansion ghalat ho to EEV check karein.

solutions.en: Do not run the unit long while the discharge is hot — clean the condenser airflow and stop before the compressor is damaged.
solutions.ur: Discharge garam ho to unit ko lamba na chalayein — condenser ki airflow saaf karein aur compressor kharab hone se pehle band kar dein.

meaning.en: Connected indoor capacity greater than outdoor allows.
meaning.ur: Lagaye hue indoor ki capacity outdoor ki ijazat se zyada hai

causes.ur: Galat IDU/ODU combination
Indoor unit zyada lag gaye

solutions.en: Disconnect power, then check the outdoor unit capacity plate and the connected indoor units against the combination chart in the manual.
solutions.ur: Pehle bijli band karein, phir outdoor unit ki capacity plate aur jude hue indoor units ko manual ke combination chart se compare karein.

solutions.en: Count the indoor units and their total capacity; if the total is above what the outdoor unit allows, switch off or remove the extra indoor units.
solutions.ur: Indoor units ki ginti karein aur un ki total capacity nikalein; total outdoor ki permission se zyada ho to extra indoor units band kar dein ya hatayein.

solutions.en: If the combination itself is wrong, reconfigure the address/settings to a supported IDU/ODU pair and restart the system.
solutions.ur: Agar combination hi ghalat ho to address/settings ko kisi supported IDU/ODU pair par set karein aur system ko dobara start karein.

meaning.en: Outdoor condenser coil temperature high — insufficient air through coil.
meaning.ur: Outdoor condenser coil temperature zyada hai — coil se hawa ka aana kam

causes.en: Blocked coil (bags, dirt) or recirculating air
causes.ur: Coil par blockage (kura, gand) ya hawa ka wapas ghoomna
System mein nitrogen ya non-condensable gas

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the unit, then clear anything blocking the outdoor condenser coil and keep front-to-back airflow open so air is not recirculated.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karke unit alag karein, phir outdoor condenser coil ko rokne wali har cheez hata dein aur aage se peeche ki airflow khuli rakhein taake hawa dobara na ghoomay.

solutions.en: Wash the coil if it is clogged with dirt or bags, and make sure the unit is not sucking its own hot exhaust back in.
solutions.ur: Coil ganda ya blocked ho to use dhoyein ya wash karein, aur confirm karein ke unit apna garam exhaust wapas andar na le raha.

solutions.en: If non-condensables such as nitrogen are suspected, have the system vented and recharged by a technician, then recheck the coil temperature.
solutions.ur: Nitrogen waghera non-condensable ka shaq ho to system ko technician se vent karwa kar recharge karwayein, phir coil ka temperature dobara check karein.

meaning.en: Not an error — unit in test mode.
meaning.ur: Yeh error nahi — unit test mode mein hai

causes.ur: Commissioning ke dauran test mode on ho gaya

solutions.en: Exit test mode per service procedure / power cycle
solutions.ur: Service procedure ke mutabiq test mode se nikalen / power cycle karein

notes.en: Only on Multi F(DX) sheet; not on Universal sheet.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf Multi F(DX) sheet par hai, Universal sheet par nahi milta.
